project: Wuxia Life P81 Renown Endgame Playable Implementation
description: Lightweight implementation of jianghu_renown_sage endgame / final legacy stage (Legacy Echo / 身后名之声). Strictly follows P80 contract: 1 auto echo event + 6 expression updates, 3 variants (叹/遥/传), no stat changes, tavern-born flavor.

userStories.title: Wire renown endgame echo event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the renown endgame echo event wired through the existing event system so players on the renown route encounter a final legacy echo with 3 distinct variants.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure renown_endgame_echo auto event in sample-lines-spine.json
Trigger conditions: renown_late_life_done + age 60-65 + mutex guard + exclude orthodox/demonic
Set renown_endgame_done checkpoint flag + renown_endgame_identity_done
Set 3 variant markers: tavern_renown_endgame_sigh / distant / legacy
Branching based on late-life branch marker (burnout→sigh, lone_wolf→distant, mentor→legacy)
No stat changes (endgame is memory, not power)
No new event framework or scheduler
No regressions in P71/P72/P73/P75/P77/P79
userStories.notes: 3 endgame echo events (sigh/distant/legacy) wired in sample-lines-spine.json. Age 60-65, auto, no stat changes. Sets renown_endgame_done + renown_endgame_identity_done + variant marker.

userStories.title: Add endgame expression — sample line core (P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want the renown endgame stage reflected in my sample line status so the route feels like it has a meaningful final legacy identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Sample line cost label: late-life → endgame (身后名·叹/遥/传)
Sample line current goal: late-life → endgame (3 distinct goals per variant)
At least 2 endgame-specific readable signals (cost label + current goal)
Three variants have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor (tavern legend angle)
No new UI components
userStories.notes: Cost labels (身后名·叹/遥/传) and current goals updated in sampleLineExpression.ts. 3 variants all distinct, tavern-born flavor preserved.

userStories.title: Add endgame expression — endgame identity (P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want an endgame identity summary that deepens my age-40 identity so the endgame stage feels like it defines the final legacy.
acceptanceCriteria: renownAge40Identity() checks renown_endgame_identity_done first
Variant A (叹): 熬干了的老传说
Variant B (遥): 传说里的神秘人
Variant C (传): 活在传说里的老掌柜
Three variants have meaningfully different identity descriptions
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
userStories.notes: Endgame identity added to renownAge40Identity() with done-flag-first pattern. 3 variants: 熬干了的老传说 / 传说里的神秘人 / 活在传说里的老掌柜.

userStories.title: Add endgame expression — ordinary origin (bonus P1)
userStories.description: As a player, I want additional endgame-specific expressions in the ordinary origin view so the endgame stage feels richer and more memorable.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary origin current goal: endgame state update (matches sample line)
Ordinary origin life memory: endgame-specific text (different per variant)
Ordinary origin summary: endgame state update (different per variant)
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
No new UI components
userStories.notes: Ordinary origin expression updated: current goal + life memory + summary for all 3 endgame variants. Tavern-born flavor preserved.

userStories.title: Add targeted endgame proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the renown endgame event fires correctly, all three variants work, and tavern-born renown flavor is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof (late-life → endgame → expression changes chain)
Show 7 core nodes: pre-endgame baseline → event fires → Var A flags+id → Var B flags+id → Var C flags+id → cost label per var → current goal per var
Optional bonus nodes: endgame identity, ordinary origin expression, full chain traceback, mutex with other lines, branch matching, tavern-born flavor check, lightweight compliance
No full lifetime exhaust required
Save as docs/test-reports/p81-renown-endgame-targeted-proof.md
userStories.notes: Targeted proof produced at docs/test-reports/p81-renown-endgame-targeted-proof.md. 7 core nodes + 7 bonus nodes all verified.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the renown endgame stage so future edits do not break the first renown endgame milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: New test file covering endgame stage
Group 1: Event wiring (3-4 tests) — existence, auto type, age range, conditions
Group 2: Pre-endgame baseline (2 tests) — post-late-life pre-endgame state
Group 3: Variant A post-endgame (3-4 tests) — flags + cost label + current goal
Group 4: Variant B post-endgame (3-4 tests) — flags + cost label + current goal
Group 5: Variant C post-endgame (3-4 tests) — flags + cost label + current goal
Group 6: No regression P71/P72/P73/P75/P77/P79 (5+ tests)
Group 7: Endgame identity verification (3-4 tests) — 3 variants + all different
No stat changes verification
Typecheck passes
~22-27 tests total
userStories.notes: 9 test groups (~30 assertions) in tests/p81TavernHandRenownEndgameSpineTests.ts. All passing. P79 regression tests pass. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Produce P81 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the renown endgame implementation and either confirms the renown route is fully closed or identifies remaining gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Output docs/test-reports/p81-renown-endgame-closure-report.md
Summarize event wiring, expression updates, targeted proof, regression test results
Clarify whether renown route is fully closed (bridge→entry→on-ramp→pressure→payoff→late-life→endgame)
List deferred larger renown-expansion items
Confirm lightweight constraint is maintained
Confirm no regressions in P71/P72/P73/P75/P77/P79
Give next stage direction recommendation (medical_sage_healer? other origin expansion?)
userStories.notes: Closure report at docs/test-reports/p81-renown-endgame-closure-report.md. Renown route fully closed: bridge → entry → on-ramp → pressure → payoff → late-life → endgame.
